title: Mixed Event — Musical Twilight Parade — Episode6 A Song to Help You Smile

meta.Episode: Episode6 — A Song to Help You Smile
meta.Event Outline: Shiho has been scouted by a band that's ready to make its big debut, giving her a lot to think about. Then, Saki invites her on a visit to Phoenix Wonderland. Meanwhile, Tsukasa and the rest of WxS make their own preparations, eager to host them!

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So we go straight down this way...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, is that it? There's a sign that says,
Wonder Stage this way!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And it's handwritten...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's nice... In a very homey way.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh!
The show's about to start too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We should hurry!
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's make today's show absolutely perfect as always!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What's the matter, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um, well... I was just a little concerned about Hoshino and her friends. They were talking so seriously before we left.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: All the more reason we should make this show our best one yet!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Our show can make them smile brightly and lighten the mood for everyone!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah... You may be right.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I just hope my singing can do that...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Your terrific singing voice will be just the thing they need to hear, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow! We're finally here!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
But it took us ten minutes to get over here...
This place is way too inaccessible.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
And yet, there's so many people here!
This is incredible!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Is it just standing room only now?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, there's enough space over there!
Hurry, let's go...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Whoa, Saki! Stop pulling!
I can walk there myself...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, it's starting...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Come one, come all! Feast your eyes and ears upon this century's greatest songstress as she sings to bring world peace!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A song that bring peace? Is such a thing possible?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course! Her song will help everyone in this land, who has lost their smile, to remember what it means to feel joy!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Do you also want to listen to her sing, everyone?

rows.Speaker: Kids
rows.Line: Yeeeah!
se_event_parade_2021_001

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They seem like different people altogether compared to a little while ago.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know, right!
They're so much brighter and livelier on stage.
This is sooo amazing...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh! Look at that...!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: I can sing too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa, that robot's amazing too!
It's so good at singing!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And it can even tap dance...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: How can it do all of this?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I must admit... That robot has got quite the singing voice, but it still can't hold a candle to our songstress!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Come forth, songstress!
Revel us with your powerful voice!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Is she gonna be okay after getting this much hype?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right, and the robot already sang so well...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: There's Kusanagi...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'll sing until my very last breath if that's what it takes to bring a smile to everyone's face.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Please, listen to my song...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This sounds so much better than what I heard the other day!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Her voice is so delicate and gentle...
She knows exactly how to express herself through song.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I really wish I could sing like that too...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She's amazing...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Everyone's better than I expected, but Nene's singing voice is especially beautiful...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But why is she performing on such a small stage if she can sing so well...?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (With this sort of talent, larger theatrical troupes should be falling over themselves trying to recruit her.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Why...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That was how the songstress brought peace to this world☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And everyone lived happily ever after...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You were all awesome!
And the show was so fun!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hehehe... You've got that right.
All of our shows are done to perfection!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
All that practice really paid off☆
Right, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And you were absolutely incredible, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you...
I had to rehearse a lot every day.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I'm glad I did...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Because everyone's smiling so brightly now...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, we still have some cleaning up to do. You girls go ahead and enjoy the rest of your Phoenix Wonderland trip!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But don't stay too late, understand?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We got it♪
Thanks for today!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
And thank you too, Wonderlands×Showtime!
It was the most fun I've had in a while♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
We had fun as well.
If you ever visit Phoenix Wonderland again,
be sure to drop by and watch our show.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah! You're always welcome here☆
Next time, I'll show you all the secret spots
that we didn't get to see today!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... See you again.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay! Let's clean up, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You don't have to tell us that...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Nene! Are you sure you want to end the day like this?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
R-Rin?! What if someone sees you?
Also, what do you mean by that...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<It's so sad to just say goodbye like this!
Why not arrange to meet again?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, I guess you're right...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We should probably leave so they can get back to cleaning up.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup, sounds good!
Hey, wanna swing by the souvenir shop?♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Kusanagi, there's something I want to ask you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Do you have time?
